title_en: In the Courtroom (1/20): A Contract Dispute
note_en: Legal Chinese loves the pattern 根据……(的规定)，… "according to (the provisions of) …", which opens many sentences here: 根据《民法典》的规定，… "Under the Civil Code, …". Note also 由: in 由被告住所地……人民法院管辖 and 诉讼费由败诉方李先生承担 it marks who is responsible for an action, like English "is borne by" or "falls to", with the verb coming after the responsible party.
